name: Mobirise
description_en:
Mobirise is a block-based website builder with desktop applications and an online AI builder. The desktop app can edit installed projects offline and publish HTML/CSS/JavaScript to a local folder or external hosting. The online builder’s export and hosted custom-domain features belong to paid BASE/GROW plans, so desktop and online entitlements must be evaluated separately.

It is useful to shortlist for a brochure site or portfolio whose owner wants local editing and control over the hosting destination. Keep the editable project as well as published files, and inventory external forms, carts and extensions: exporting a page does not eliminate those service dependencies or grant an open-source license to the builder.
description_zh:
Mobirise 是区块式建站工具，提供桌面应用和在线 AI 构建器。桌面应用可离线编辑已安装项目，将 HTML/CSS/JavaScript 发布到本地文件夹或外部主机。在线构建器的导出和托管自定义域名属于付费 BASE/GROW 方案，应分别评估桌面与在线权利。

希望本地编辑并控制托管目的地的展示站或作品集可以考虑它。除发布文件外，还应保存可编辑项目，并清点外部表单、购物车和扩展依赖；导出页面不会消除这些服务依赖，也不代表建站器采用开源许可。

core_features.explanation_en: Desktop projects can publish to local files or supported external hosting, while sign-in, AI and new downloads still require connectivity.
core_features.explanation_zh: 桌面项目可发布到本地文件或受支持的外部主机，但登录、AI 及新内容下载仍需网络。

core_features.explanation_en: The editor imports project.mobirise rather than arbitrary published HTML; export the project separately for backup or moving devices.
core_features.explanation_zh: 编辑器导入 project.mobirise，不能导入任意已发布 HTML，应单独导出项目用于备份或迁移设备。

core_features.name_zh: 在线站点与 AI 配额
core_features.explanation_en: BASE includes 3 hosted online sites and 100 monthly generations; GROW includes 10 and 1,000, independent of unlimited external publishing.
core_features.explanation_zh: BASE 含 3 个托管在线站和每月 100 次生成，GROW 为 10 个及 1,000 次，与外部发布不限次数的范围分开。

pricing.summary_en: Free desktop editor/basic theme and external publishing. Current BASE/GROW one-year kits display $199/$249; homepage $149 KIT and hosted-free help claims differ. Taxes, renewal, hosting scope and currency need confirmation.
pricing.summary_zh: 免费桌面编辑器/基础主题及外部发布；当前 BASE/GROW 一年 kit 显示 $199/$249，首页 $149 KIT 与免费托管帮助文案有差异，税费、续费、托管范围及币种需确认。

sections.title_en: Choose desktop or online before building
sections.title_zh: 先选择桌面或在线工作方式
sections.en: The homepage describes desktop apps for Windows, Mac and Linux and a browser AI route. Start with a basic theme and blocks, replace text/images, set global styles and inspect phone/tablet/desktop previews. AI drafts can be brought to desktop through Import by Link. Desktop offline work covers installed themes and blocks, not sign-in, cloud generation, buying plans or downloading updates. The pricing FAQ only names Windows/Mac for its shared account walkthrough, so confirm premium Linux compatibility for the actual version rather than inferring every platform entitlement from the homepage.
sections.zh: 首页描述 Windows、Mac、Linux 桌面应用及浏览器 AI 路径。可从基础主题与区块开始，替换文本/图片、设置全局样式，并检查手机/平板/桌面预览。AI 草稿可通过 Import by Link 带入桌面。桌面离线工作覆盖已安装主题和区块，不覆盖登录、云生成、购买方案或下载更新。定价 FAQ 的共享账户说明仅列 Windows/Mac，因此实际版本的 Linux 高级能力仍需确认，不能由首页推断全部平台权利。

sections.title_en: Publish files and preserve editable projects
sections.title_zh: 发布文件并保留可编辑项目
sections.en: The homepage says desktop local HTML/CSS/JavaScript publishing is available on every plan, including Free; online export requires BASE/GROW. The publishing guide offers local folder, FTP-family transfer and GitHub Pages, and warns some scripts work only online. Keep a native project backup: Sites → project gear → Export site. Restore through Sites → Import Mobirise site and select project.mobirise. The editor cannot reconstruct a project by importing published HTML or another tool’s template. Editing a restored project does not update its public site until you publish again. Test forms, carts, links and asset paths on the real destination before switching a domain.
sections.zh: 首页称所有桌面方案包括 Free 都可发布本地 HTML/CSS/JavaScript，在线导出要求 BASE/GROW。发布指南提供本地文件夹、FTP 类传输和 GitHub Pages，并提醒部分脚本仅在线运行。应保留原生项目备份：Sites → 项目齿轮 → Export site；恢复时用 Sites → Import Mobirise site 选择 project.mobirise。编辑器不能通过已发布 HTML 或其他工具模板重建项目。修改恢复项目不会更新公开站点，需再次发布。切换域名前应在真实目的地主机测试表单、购物车、链接和资源路径。

sections.title_en: Separate the free app from annual premium access
sections.title_zh: 区分免费应用与年度高级权利
sections.en: The current pricing page displays BASE $199 and GROW $249 for a kit providing themes/extensions, hosted online sites and AI features for one year. BASE has 3 online sites/100 monthly generations and GROW 10/1,000; online sites are those hosted in the Mobirise account, while external hosting publication is unlimited. AI quota resets monthly and reaching it does not prevent ordinary editing/publishing. The homepage also quotes a $149/year KIT, without reconciling it to these current BASE/GROW packages. Do not substitute that lower amount for a BASE quote. Currency code, renewal total and taxes require checkout confirmation. The kit account covers up to two computers; extra seats require another arrangement.
sections.zh: 当前定价页显示 BASE $199、GROW $249，kit 提供一年的主题/扩展、在线托管站点和 AI 能力。BASE 为 3 个在线站/每月 100 次生成，GROW 为 10 个/1,000 次；在线站指托管于 Mobirise 账户的站点，外部主机发布不限数量。AI 配额每月重置，用尽不妨碍普通编辑/发布。首页另报 $149/年 KIT，但未解释其与当前 BASE/GROW 的关系，不能用较低金额代替 BASE 报价。货币代码、续费总额及税费需结账确认，kit 账户最多用于两台电脑，更多席位另行安排。

sections.title_zh: 明确到期后停止哪些能力
sections.en: The pricing FAQ says published sites continue, but premium block adding/editing, new releases, updates and support stop, and some third-party extensions such as ElectricBlaze stop working on published sites. July 2026 terms specifically protect exported files on your own hosting as independent files, yet reserve removal of Mobirise-hosted sites and related form submissions when a paid service ends. This limits the broad marketing promise: do not rely on permanent vendor-hosted availability after cancellation. The help publishing article also describes the free hosted address as test-only requiring a Site license for constant use, whereas the current homepage promises three free hosted sites; confirm which hosted plan applies before relying on sustained free service.
sections.zh: 定价 FAQ 称已发布站点继续存在，但不能继续添加/编辑高级区块，且新发布、更新和支持停止，部分 ElectricBlaze 等第三方扩展会在已发布站点停止工作。2026 年 7 月条款明确自有主机上的导出文件独立运行，却保留付费服务结束后移除 Mobirise 托管站点及相关表单提交的权利。这限制了营销概述，不能依赖取消后永久保留厂商托管。发布帮助文章另称免费托管地址仅供测试，持续使用需 Site 许可，而当前首页说有三个免费托管站；依赖持续免费服务前应确认具体适用方案。

sections.title_en: Check service dependencies and usage rights
sections.title_zh: 检查服务依赖及使用权
sections.en: Terms grant a limited license to the app/themes/extensions for your own or client websites; third-party/open-source components have their own licenses. Do not treat free commercial use or code export as an open-source license to Mobirise itself, or resell generated designs as reusable unlimited-customer templates. Paid services can auto-renew; the 14-day refund applies to the initial order, excluding upgrades, renewals and some third-party services. For a static brochure site, external hosting and project backups can provide a clear maintenance route. For a dynamic application, inventory form processing, checkout, authentication and plugin dependencies first. No software installation, export, host transfer, AI generation or checkout was executed here.
sections.zh: 条款对应用、主题和扩展授予用于自有或客户网站的有限许可，第三方/开源组件适用各自许可。免费商用或代码导出不能当作 Mobirise 本身开源，也不能将生成设计转售为供无限客户复用的模板。付费服务可能自动续费；14 天退款仅适用于初次订单，不适用于升级、续费及部分第三方服务。静态展示站可通过外部托管和项目备份形成维护路径；动态应用应先清点表单处理、结账、认证和插件依赖。本次未安装软件、导出、迁移主机、生成 AI 内容或结账。

content_method.author: Codex (AI assistant)
content_method.method: Public primary-source research, original English editorial synthesis and Chinese translation. Hypothetical examples are not executed tests.

research_gaps.en: Hosted-free entitlement and post-expiry retention conflict across marketing/help/terms; obtain plan-specific confirmation and keep independent backups.
research_gaps.zh: 营销、帮助、条款间的免费托管及到期保留范围冲突，应确认具体方案并保留独立备份。

research_gaps.en: Current Linux premium compatibility, forms/service quotas, real export completeness and external extensions were not tested.
research_gaps.zh: 未实测当前 Linux 高级兼容性、表单/服务配额、真实导出完整性及外部扩展。
